request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Manaring Weasel".

Creative brief
Name: Manaring Weasel
Collection: Arcane Menagerie. Wild creatures altered by concentrated magic, with crystalline anatomy, runes, echoes, orbiting objects, and unusual projectile behavior.
Core concept: A rapid disruptor that throws expanding rings from its elongated body.
Body and silhouette: Long flexible weasel with short legs, pointed head, and curled tail forming a circle.
Signature features: Floating mana rings, glowing belly marks, and crystal whiskers.
Palette and materials: Dark turquoise, cream, muted violet, and bright blue light.
Movement personality: Playful, restless, and difficult to pin down.
Attack concept: Curls briefly into a loop before firing three expanding rings with alternating open gaps.
Directional details: The tail’s crystal tip points inward from the left side of the loop.
Avoid: Ferret pet appearance, solid unavoidable rings, overly soft magical glow.
